may-learn-seek-cli-opinion-when-material.rationale: Seek another opinion only when it can change a material decision; skip it when evidence is decisive and the choice is cheap to reverse.

may-learn-packetize-independent-cli-revi.rationale: Independent advice uses a fresh context and one neutral packet with trusted evidence, expected result, and stop condition.

may-learn-handle-cli-timeout-and-retry.rationale: Accepted work is incomplete; May waits for terminal evidence, classifies failures, inspects artifacts, and changes the failed assumption before retrying.

may-learn-reconcile-cli-disagreement.rationale: Worker opinions are advice. May resolves disagreement with primary evidence, seeks a third view only for remaining material uncertainty, and owns the final action.
